kinds.d: Swing or sling hung from a frame, door or ceiling that supports a person during intimacy.
Bench, cross or frame made to restrain a person; a cushion that only positions the body is in Soft Furnishings.

notes: Restraint-only. Both kinds kept with their old models; mounting and form variants as types per plan. Positioning cushions stay in Soft Furnishings. No other makers added (that would need a web pass).
